title: Megurine Luka — Precise Advice〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (“Add up all the joy you've felt since you met”...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm never going to get tired of hearing that.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka, it's you.
I was wondering who was listening to that song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Be my guest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This really is a wonderful song.
It has this way of filling your heart with so much warmth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it really does...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we're only able to listen to it now because you gave Ichika such great advice, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I appreciate the compliment, but that won't score you any freebies with me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, all I did was give her a little push. Given the opportunity, those girls always know how to figure out what's most important.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True. They really are an amazing bunch.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It started with hearing that those two were their fans, but they ended up doing so much for them...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Because they're such nice girls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I'm beyond glad that they got this song ready in time for their show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. Their tough schedule definitely started taking its toll on them, but they made sure to support each other the entire way...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's like they were able to clear the goal and say, “Our thoughts and feelings won out!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I was honestly pretty worried about them burning out partway through because of how hard they had to try.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you were?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believed that they'd pull through in the end because of the power of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha! Talk about being a senior.
You really know what your juniors are like, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the same time, I stand to learn a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Again, MEIKO, stop putting me on a pedestal. You're just as important to them, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it must be true coming from you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, I get it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
There's something I want to ask you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course, it's about the girls.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was joking about that “senior” bit just now, but you and Miku have known them longer than I have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So I've been meaning to ask more about what they're like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll answer as best I can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks! About Ichika...
I was totally blown away by her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For example, she's the one who invited Hanano and her brother to see another show, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I heard that as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow. I was under the impression that Saki would be the one to act first since this had to do with a pair of siblings...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This must be right out of “The Legend of Ichi the Mighty”...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Did Saki tell you about that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, Miku told me.
Apparently, Ichika used to be the bold and daring type.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like the time when she used her textbook as an umbrella to keep Saki from getting wet, or the time she jumped in to save Honami from some mean boys.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: True. But she's still pretty bold and daring now, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I heard that she saved this girl from some aggressive solicitors just the other day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard that too.
As reliable as ever, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she really is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She may regain more of these wonderful qualities as her resolve continues to build, and blossom into this shining symbol of hope...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why I can't wait to see how Ichika as we know her develops moving forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, I can't believe you're telling me all this. You must really be in a mood to talk today, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so?
If that's the case...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This song may be the reason why.
